findings.summary: Package provenance still does not bind a source checkout to the configured installation control state, and direct-archive staging is not restart-clean or explicitly bounded.
findings.evidence: A disposable copied checkout was given two valid owner-only control directories. GEW_INSTALLATION_CONTROL_ROOT named A, while only B was placed on sys.path; built-in implementation provenance was accepted. Separately, an exact direct archive imported successfully and staged verified adapter bytes, then an abrupt process exit bypassed atexit. A subsequent successful direct-archive run left the original staging directory untouched. Inspection also found no configured finite bound on staged adapter member count, individual size or aggregate bytes.
findings.required_change: Resolve source-checkout authority from the one explicit installation-control reference supplied by the supported bootstrap/runtime configuration and bind it to the active installation identity; do not discover authority by scanning arbitrary sys.path entries. For direct archives, apply configured finite count/per-file/aggregate staging limits before allocation, keep byte and identity verification, use a dedicated installation-owned staging namespace, remove abandoned generations deterministically at startup, never reuse a prior generation, and retain cleanup on every normal and exceptional path.
mechanical_closure_tests: Configure installation control A, expose a distinct internally valid control B through sys.path, and assert source provenance, factory issue and all adapter calls reject; the exact A-bound checkout must initialize and run all five built-ins.
Exercise missing, mismatched and multiple configured control references and assert the checkout stops deterministically before provenance resolution or adapter issue.

Terminate a direct-archive process after staging without running exit handlers, start a new process, and assert the abandoned generation is removed, never imported or reused, while the new verified generation runs all five built-ins and is cleaned.
Exceed configured staged member count, per-member bytes and aggregate bytes independently and assert rejection before unbounded allocation or package initialization.
Retain the exact development-checkout, extracted-package and direct-archive five-adapter happy paths and all existing incomplete/ambiguous package-layout rejections.
